description: The VIAVI Network Digital Twin is a set of commercial test and simulation products that together build digital replicas of a mobile network, from radio access to core, using AI and field data from VIAVI's own instruments and software. It combines TeraVM AI RAN Scenario Generation (RSG), which simulates system-level radio access network behaviour on real or synthetic maps with configurable topologies, mobility patterns and traffic profiles for 4G, 5G, emerging 6G and non-terrestrial networks; the TM500, which emulates thousands of mobile devices for base station and Open RAN testing; VIAVI Ray Tracing, a near real-time channel generator and 3D planning tool for detailed scenarios such as beams inside buildings and massive MIMO optimisation; and the VAMOS automation system for test campaigns. VIAVI sells the parts separately or as complete twins for devices, radio access or non-terrestrial networks, and adds an AIOps platform that captures live traffic. Coverage: any network the operator models. Format and access: commercial hardware, software and cloud products; brochures and contact on request. Caveats: proprietary and aimed at vendors and operators; realism depends on operator data. Simulation uses: testing radio access networks under traffic surges, site outages and new configurations without touching live service, and validating AI control apps. Related records: the Colosseum Open RAN digital twin and BubbleRAN MX-DT are other network twins, and Sionna and Altair WinProp offer ray tracing.
